fee_notes: Chick-fil-A does not charge an initial license fee. Prior to opening, the licensee must purchase opening inventory from an approved distributor; if CFA Supply is the distributor, those payments are estimated at $15,000–$65,000, but are not due until after the unit opens and are not characterized as an initial franchise fee.
raw_excerpt: Chick-fil-A does not charge you an initial license payment or fee to obtain a Chick-fil-A license.
